Presenting SAMBHAL JAYE ZARA FULL VIDEO SONG from PARVARISH movie starring Amitabh Bachchan, Vinod Khanna, Shabana Azmi, Neetu Singh in lead roles, released in 1977. The song is sung by Lata Mangeshkar, Usha Mangeshkar and music is given by Laxmikant-Pyarelal, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song : SAMBHAL JAYE ZARA
Singer: LATA MANGESHKAR, USHA MANGESHKAR
Music Director : LAXMIKANT-PYARELAL
Lyricist : MAJROOH SULTANPURI
Parvarish was a "Hit" and the fourth highest grossing film of the year at the Box office and M. Desai's one of four hits that year.
